title: If two people reassign at once, the later change wins after refresh
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Two users (two logins/browsers) both viewing the same work order in Board/Tech View.
custom_steps:
1. User 1 reassigns the work order to technician B.
  2. User 2 reassigns the same work order to technician C a moment later.
  3. Both users refresh.
  4. Confirm the final lead is C (the later change) for both.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When two users reassign the same work order, the later change wins.
  • After a concurrent reassignment, both users see the final lead once they refresh.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Story 4 Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S4-E2, S4-E7 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
